name: Mefenorex
summary: Mefenorex (marketed as Rondimen, Pondinil, Anexate), also known as N-(3-chloropropyl)amphetamine, is an amphetamine derivative with a relatively mild psychostimulant profile. Developed in the 1960s, it was used throughout the 1970s as an appetite suppressant for treating obesity.

pharmacology.text: Mefenorex is a prodrug of amphetamine; upon ingestion, the compound will begin to metabolize into, as well as promote the production of, the active metabolites levoamphetamine and dextroamphetamine.

uses.text: Mefenorex (marketed as Rondimen, Pondinil, Anexate), also known as N-(3-chloropropyl)amphetamine, is an amphetamine derivative with a relatively mild psychostimulant profile. Developed in the 1960s, it was used throughout the 1970s as an appetite suppressant for treating obesity.

sideEffects.en: Its effects are those of amphetamine, including sleeplessness, a faster heart rate, raised blood pressure, dry mouth, anxiety and loss of appetite. It can be misused and can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它的作用與安非他命相同，包括失眠、心跳加快、血壓上升、口乾、焦慮與食慾減退。它可能被濫用，也可能導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的作用与安非他命相同，包括失眠、心跳加快、血压上升、口干、焦虑与食欲减退。它可能被滥用，也可能导致依赖。

fact.en: Mefenorex is amphetamine with a chloropropyl chain attached to its nitrogen, and the body breaks it down into amphetamine itself.
fact.zh: 美芬雷司是在安非他命的氮原子上接一條氯丙基鏈，身體會把它分解成安非他命本身。
fact.zhHans: 美芬雷司是在安非他命的氮原子上接一条氯丙基链，身体会把它分解成安非他命本身。
